name: Kobweb Official Website
description:
Create web apps in Kotlin!

Kobweb is an opinionated framework built on top of Compose HTML.

It includes everything you need to build rich, dynamic websites, as well as web applications, while being able to leverage the greater Kotlin ecosystem.

name: YouTube Redesigned
description:
Reimagine YouTube: A Stunning, Next-Gen Experience.

A sleek, modern YouTube redesign crafted with Kotlin/JS and Kobweb. Experience your favorite content like never before! Features dynamic drawers, intuitive playlists, immersive theater mode, and keyboard shortcuts.

name: Weaved
description: Weaved is a browser extension made with Kobweb and a mobile app that lets you highlight and comment on any website, embedding discussions directly into the web. Join the conversation and see what others are saying in context. The homepage features live preview code shared from the extension module itself.
tags: Collaboration, Browser Extension, Unique Use Case

name: LUX Energy
description: Zenmo Simulations develops the open-source LUX energy twin to accelerate the transition to sustainable energy. Rooted in academic research from TU Eindhoven, the company builds quantitative, agent-based models to manage semi-autonomous energy systems and resolve grid congestion. Through foundation projects like SparkCity, NEON, and HOLON, they create practical digital twins that empower local energy hubs and businesses to efficiently integrate solar, wind, and electric mobility solutions. The scope includes: Agent-based modeling, Zero-emission transition, Digital energy twins.
